6946.html:
6946 nánāndr̥ f. 'husband's sister' RV., nanandr̥-, nandā-, nandinī- f. lex. [nandā- due to association with nándati (EWA ii 131) and perh. infl. by early NIA. nan(a)d-]
    Pa. nanandar- f.; Pk. ṇaṇaṁdā- 'husband's younger sister'; Shum. nanā́nikyem 'my brother's wife'; S. niṇun f. 'husband's sister'; L. nināṇ f. 'husband's brother's wife', (Ju.) 'husband's sister', awāṇ. nināṇ 'his sister'; P. nanāṇ, naṇad f. 'his sister', naṇānū f. 'his younger sister', ludh. nanãd f. 'his sister', WPah. (Joshi) naṇad f.; Ku. nand 'his younter sister', gng. nãṛ̃d, N. nanda, A. nandi, B. nanad, Or. naṇa(n)da; Mth. nan(a)dī 'his sister'; H. nana(n)d, nanadī, °diyā, nandī f. 'husband's sister', nanadinī f. 'husband's or wife's sister'; Marw. naṇad f. 'husband's sister'; OG. naṇaṁdara f., G. naṇãd, naṇdal, naṇdī f. 'his younger sister'; M. naṇãd, °ṇad, naṇdolī, °dulī f. 'his sister', Ko. naṇada; Si. nä(n̆)dī, nändā 'father's sister, wife's mother'.
    nā́nāndra-; nanāndr̥pati-, *nanāndr̥putra-.

3855.html:
3855 *khasa² 'rough'. 2. *khasara-. [For similar words see kakkhaṭa-]
    1. B. khas 'harsh, rough (to touch)', khaskhas, Or. khasakhasiā; H. khaskhas f. 'harsh sound'; — A. khahaṭā 'rough'; — B. khasṛā 'rough draft'? — N. khaskhas 'tickling in the throat', khasmasāunu 'to have a sore throat'; A. kahmah 'rubbing sound'.
    2. K. khasurᵘ m. 'gravel'; S. khahuro 'rough'; N. khasro 'rough, coarse, thick'.
    khasa-³ 'a partic. tribe' see khaśa-.
